title: Ginger (Green): modeled ₹1,631/qtl left, Perumbavoor → Athirampuzha
summary: January 2024: reported ginger (Green) prices at Perumbavoor and Athirampuzha imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 100% of 24 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹1,631 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 364 same-variety market pairs screened for ginger (Green) in January 2024; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (Green Ginger, FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Athirampuzha report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: January 2024
scenes.caption: Perumbavoor (Kerala) and Athirampuzha (Kerala) both reported ginger (Green) prices for the same variety and grade (Green Ginger, FAQ) on 24 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Perumbavoor reported a median ₹9,500 per quintal. Athirampuzha reported a median ₹12,500 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹2,750/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹2,750 per quintal, and Athirampuzha was dearer on 100% of days.

scenes.headline: 64 km by road
scenes.caption: 64 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~1 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹14/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹1,324 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹691 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Athirampuzha report, the rule selects 24 of 24 modeled shipping days. 24 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹1,631 per quintal (₹996 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Ginger (Green) route from Perumbavoor to Athirampuzha was positive on 100% of matched days in January 2024. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹163,100, or ₹99,600 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to ginger (Green)
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹14/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Ginger (Green) route from Perumbavoor to Athirampuzha was positive on 100% of matched days in January 2024. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹163,100, or ₹99,600 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

scenes.caption: The modeled Ginger (Green) route from Narnaul to Una was positive on 100% of matched days in December 2024. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹119,800, or ₹86,900 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
